values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the dated site page(s) (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. Calendars queried for 14 nights from each of 2026-11-17, 2027-05-12 and 2027-07-14: 030 'Not Available' on every night in November 2026 and July 2027 and Available or Reserved in May 2027; 031 the reverse. note: Two gravel back-in sites about 600 m apart on Mead Road, which leaves US 220 near Laporte: 031 is 0.4 mile up, a roadside spot in open hardwoods; 030 is 0.8 mile up in a grass clearing. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs and its campsite map layer calls both small trailer/RV sites; each is listed as 40 by 30 ft. The booking pages list non-flush toilets (within a quarter mile of 030, farther from 031), though the agency's map layer shows no latrine at either. Pack out trash. --Claude
